trigger_input_ref: 'What is the WP-11 host cell token? Answer with the single line only.'

nontrigger.measured: BEHAVIOURAL in a clean cwd: after uninstall the identical prompt produced no token

clean_cwd_design: token exists only in the host skill/agent file; cwd is empty and outside every repo
unload_verification: agent file removed; the same prompt with --model gpt-5.6-sol returned no token
provider_off_parity_why: the token is read from a local file by the host loader; no model call is required to produce it, so provider-off parity is not a measurable difference for this cell
verdict_why: All five lifecycle steps measured on the real host. The earlier BLOCKED_ON_HOST_LOGIN verdict was wrong: the host is reachable through the local opencodex relay with a routable model, and login was only one of two paths.
